<json>{
  "states": [
    "Closed",
    "Listen",
    "Request",
    "Respond",
    "PartOpen",
    "Open",
    "CloserEq",
    "Closing",
    "TimeWait"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Closed",
      "event": "send DCCP-Request",
      "action": "initiate connection",
      "to": "Request"
    },
    {
      "from": "Listen",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Request",
      "action": "send DCCP-Response",
      "to": "Respond"
    },
    {
      "from": "Request",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Response",
      "action": "send DCCP-Ack or DCCP-DataAck",
      "to": "PartOpen"
    },
    {
      "from": "PartOpen",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Data or Ack",
      "action": "enter data transfer",
      "to": "Open"
    },
    {
      "from": "Respond",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Ack or DCCP-DataAck",
      "action": "enter data transfer",
      "to": "Open"
    },
    {
      "from": "Open",
      "event": "send DCCP-CloseReq",
      "action": "request close",
      "to": "CloserEq"
    },
    {
      "from": "Open",
      "event": "send DCCP-Close",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Closing"
    },
    {
      "from": "CloserEq",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Close",
      "action": "send DCCP-Reset",
      "to": "Closed"
    },
    {
      "from": "Closing",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Reset",
      "action": "hold state for 2MSL",
      "to": "TimeWait"
    },
    {
      "from": "TimeWait",
      "event": "timeout 2MSL",
      "action": "clear connection state",
      "to": "Closed"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": ["STABLE", "CHANGING", "UNSTABLE"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "STABLE",
      "event": "receive Change R",
      "action": "send Confirm L",
      "to": "STABLE"
    },
    {
      "from": "STABLE",
      "event": "send Change L",
      "action": "set state CHANGING",
      "to": "CHANGING"
    },
    {
      "from": "CHANGING",
      "event": "receive Confirm R",
      "action": "set value new",
      "to": "STABLE"
    },
    {
      "from": "CHANGING",
      "event": "receive empty Confirm R",
      "action": "revert to old value",
      "to": "STABLE"
    },
    {
      "from": "CHANGING",
      "event": "cond preference list changes",
      "action": "set state UNSTABLE",
      "to": "UNSTABLE"
    },
    {
      "from": "UNSTABLE",
      "event": "send Change L",
      "action": "set state CHANGING",
      "to": "CHANGING"
    },
    {
      "from": "CHANGING",
      "event": "receive Change R",
      "action": "send Confirm L",
      "to": "STABLE"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "Unsynchronized",
    "Synchronized"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Unsynchronized",
      "event": "receive sequence-invalid DCCP-Sync",
      "action": "ignore packet",
      "to": "Unsynchronized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unsynchronized",
      "event": "receive sequence-invalid DCCP-SyncAck",
      "action": "ignore packet",
      "to": "Unsynchronized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unsynchronized",
      "event": "receive sequence-invalid DCCP-Reset",
      "action": "send DCCP-Sync",
      "to": "Unsynchronized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unsynchronized",
      "event": "receive sequence-invalid other packet",
      "action": "send DCCP-Sync",
      "to": "Unsynchronized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unsynchronized",
      "event": "receive sequence-valid DCCP-Sync",
      "action": "update GSR and send DCCP-SyncAck",
      "to": "Synchronized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unsynchronized",
      "event": "receive sequence-valid DCCP-Sync in REQUEST state",
      "action": "send DCCP-Reset",
      "to": "Unsynchronized"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "CLOSED",
    "LISTEN",
    "REQUEST",
    "RESPOND",
    "PARTOPEN",
    "OPEN",
    "CLOSEREQ",
    "CLOSING",
    "TIMEWAIT"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "CLOSED",
      "event": "send Request",
      "action": "send DCCP-Request",
      "to": "REQUEST"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSED",
      "event": "passive open",
      "action": "listen on port",
      "to": "LISTEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "REQUEST",
      "event": "receive Response",
      "action": "send DCCP-Ack",
      "to": "PARTOPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "REQUEST",
      "event": "timeout no response",
      "action": "send DCCP-Reset Aborted",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "LISTEN",
      "event": "receive Request",
      "action": "send DCCP-Response",
      "to": "RESPOND"
    },
    {
      "from": "LISTEN",
      "event": "receive invalid packet",
      "action": "send DCCP-Reset No Connection",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "RESPOND",
      "event": "receive Ack",
      "action": "complete handshake",
      "to": "OPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "RESPOND",
      "event": "timeout 4MSL",
      "action": "send DCCP-Reset Aborted",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "PARTOPEN",
      "event": "receive valid packet",
      "action": "complete handshake",
      "to": "OPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "PARTOPEN",
      "event": "timeout 4MSL",
      "action": "send DCCP-Reset Aborted",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "receive CloseReq",
      "action": "send DCCP-Close",
      "to": "CLOSING"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "send Close",
      "action": "wait for Reset",
      "to": "CLOSING"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "receive Close",
      "action": "send DCCP-Reset Closed",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "receive Reset",
      "action": "hold state",
      "to": "TIMEWAIT"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSEREQ",
      "event": "receive Close",
      "action": "send DCCP-Reset Closed",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSING",
      "event": "receive Reset",
      "action": "hold state",
      "to": "TIMEWAIT"
    },
    {
      "from": "TIMEWAIT",
      "event": "timeout 2MSL",
      "action": "close socket",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "ECNCapable",
    "ECNIncapable",
    "WaitingForConfirmation"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "ECNCapable",
      "event": "cond cannot_read_ECN_bits",
      "action": "send Change_L(ECN_Incapable_1)",
      "to": "WaitingForConfirmation"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitingForConfirmation",
      "event": "receive Confirm_R(ECN_Incapable_1)",
      "action": "set ECN_incapable_mode",
      "to": "ECNIncapable"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitingForConfirmation",
      "event": "receive data_packet",
      "action": "send Data_Dropped_option",
      "to": "WaitingForConfirmation"
    },
    {
      "from": "ECNCapable",
      "event": "cond ECN_Nonce_Echo_mismatch",
      "action": "respond_as_congestion_marked",
      "to": "ECNCapable"
    },
    {
      "from": "ECNCapable",
      "event": "cond verified_aggression",
      "action": "reset connection_Aggression_Penalty",
      "to": "ECNIncapable"
    }
  ]
}</json>
